title: Create PIN
summary: Second typing step: the person picks the 8-digit PIN (senha de 8 números) and types it again. The PIN locks the app and authorises the way back into the account (ADR 0057, ADR 0059).

step.description: create: first entry. confirm: the same PIN again.

pin.description: Digits typed in this step, at most pinLength. Never logged, never kept after the step ends.

firstPin.description: The PIN from the create step, held in memory until confirm ends.

problem.description: Why the PIN cannot be used. repeatedDigit, sequence and date come from pinProblem(); mismatch: the confirm entry differs.

typeDigit.effect: Adds the digit. At pinLength digits in create, runs pinProblem(): a problem sets problem and clears pin; none goes to confirm. At pinLength digits in confirm, a match goes to signup-fallback with the PIN; a mismatch sets problem to mismatch and goes back to create.

deleteDigit.effect: Removes the last digit and clears problem.

back.effect: From confirm, goes back to create and forgets firstPin. From create, goes back to signup-name.

notes: pinLength, the weak-PIN rule and its order are in registries/accounts.json; cases in test-vectors/pins.json. Bipe logic: BipePIN.problem and BipePIN.sanitize (iOS), BipePin.problem and BipePin.sanitizeInput (Android). Do not write a new check.
A full-screen number pad with the system digit keyboard as fallback. Paste is allowed; the app keeps the digits only.
The PIN goes to the server in POST /v1/signup (pin), which checks it again (400 pin_weak). Sign-up never turns the app lock on (ADR 0137); app-lock sets its own PIN when the user turns it on.
The words on screen are senha and senha de 8 números, never PIN (linguagem.md section 4).
